# Winding Public API


<!-- WARNING: THIS FILE WAS AUTOGENERATED! DO NOT EDIT! -->

## Overview

Re-exports the full public API for `emachines.winding`.

Importing from `emachines.winding` gives access to all public symbols
without needing to know which submodule they live in.

## Usage

``` python
from emachines.winding import *
# or selectively:
from emachines.winding import pitch_factor
from emachines.winding import mmf_distribution
from emachines.winding import get_basic_params
```
